findings.desc: quality: proofstory.ts:1701 uncovered_required_milestones remediation hint template (`"milestones":[... update status/checklistRefs/verificationIntentRefs for: <ids> ...]`) implies a partial update of only the uncovered rows, but `milestone_ledger_set` is documented and implemented as full-replace (CLI help: "Replace the story milestone ledger for multi-deliverable intent"; buildMilestoneLedger in proofstory.ts:386-411 sets `milestones` directly from `args.milestones`, no merge with the existing ledger). An operator/agent that follows the hint literally and submits only the listed uncovered milestone rows will silently wipe every other row from the ledger (data loss of already-confirmed milestone state), and the hint itself is not literally copy-pasteable JSON (the `...` placeholders are invalid JSON syntax), contradicting the surrounding code comment at proofstory.ts:1679-1681 which frames it as turning the failure mode "into a copy-paste". The hint should either show the full-ledger-replace requirement explicitly or point at milestone_ledger_add (which does append/merge) for single-row remediation.

adversarial: review-pass provenance (B-3b05 CHK-002) persists `provenanceFlag: "same_session_write"` on ReviewPass records (packages/main/src/handlers/finding.ts:397) as part of what review-pass-provenance.ts:20 calls a "durable per-session audit trail", but `provenanceFlag` is NOT included in the versioned v3 signature payload in signReviewPass/verifyReviewPass (packages/main/src/core/finding-verify.ts:117-146 lists version, salt, storyId, id, agent, note, timestamp, reviewRound, reviewRunId, writerSessionId, sessionSource, readManifest/readLog/readDiagnostics -- no provenanceFlag). Only writerSessionId/sessionSource are tamper-protected. Reproduced directly against the built dist: signing a record with writerSessionId+sessionSource then adding provenanceFlag=same_session_write afterward still verifies true via verifyReviewPass -- i.e. provenanceFlag can be added, stripped, or flipped in the persisted review-passes.json post-write without invalidating _hash, silently erasing or fabricating self-sign evidence for the exact B-8038/B-3928/B-f458 self-sign detection problem this story exists to address. This is compounded by delivery evidence at .lattice/story/actives/B-3b05/evidence/provenance-warn-transcript.md:50, which explicitly (and incorrectly) claims the persisted record has writerSessionId, sessionSource, AND provenanceFlag "all bound into the versioned `_hash` signature domain" -- that claim is false for provenanceFlag and should be corrected, or provenanceFlag should be added to the v3 signature domain.
